budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion of a senior building-permit program, including a construction value limit of $10,000 and a sixty-five-and-older age threshold; no decision recorded.
budget_items.quote: discussion ensued on making this for ages sixty-five and older as well as setting a construction value limit such as $10,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Franco asked how many permits are applied for each year and the current cost of a permit; no figure was printed in the minutes.
budget_items.quote: mr. franco asked how many permits are currently applied for each year as well as the current cost of a permit.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The board should consider a formal request to Unitil about electric prices and the hardship for older adults; the Select Board liaison said the Select Board would sign on. No figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the board should consider writing a formal request to unitil regarding electric prices and the hardship that it creates for older adults.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The first property tax deferral application was to go before the Board of Assessors later that afternoon. No figure printed.
